title: Sing When You're Winning — Matched-Control Execution Receipt

scientific_result.reason: At least eight provenance-matched same-physical-subject controls pass the original broad SOURCE + ONE_WORLD + singular object/event/action-anchor chain.
scientific_result.reason_new: None of the 24 controls in this enriched panel was classified as having a genuine outcome-bearing external receipt, but the panel was not random or blind and is clustered by artist/series.
scientific_result.most_important_methodological_gain: The experiment now distinguishes physical source, represented identity, lineage, broad scene anchor, and outcome-bearing receipt instead of collapsing them into one semantic score.

claim_ceiling: This receipt establishes execution integrity and direct counterexamples to the broad formulation. It does not establish statistical rarity, causality, authorial intent, retrocausality, supernatural signaling, or a JANUS-specific external mechanism.
